newsitem.title: USA: Nu Skin Asia's IPO shares increased to 9.1 mln.
newsitem.headline: Nu Skin Asia's IPO shares increased to 9.1 mln.

text.p: The number of shares in Nu Skin Asia Pacific Inc's initial public offering has been raised to 9.1 million shares from 7.6 million shares, said lead underwriter Merrill Lynch on Thursday.
The shares are expected to price in a range of $20 to $22 per share.

Nu Skin is a network marketing company involved in the distribution and sale of personal care and nutritional products. According to its filing, the company is the exclusive distribution vehicle for Provo, Utah-based Nu Skin International Inc in Japan, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and South Korea - where it currently has operations - and in Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, China, Singapore and Vietnam, where operations have not started.
The IPO is set to price late on Thursday for trading on Friday on the New York Stock Exchange. The proposed stock symbol is NUS.N.
